left.heading: Without telephone line supervision
left.alt: Wiring diagram: control panel to G16T without telephone line supervision. Panel +AUX to G16T +DC, -AUX to -DC, TIP to TIP, RING to RING. G16T terminals OUT, COM, A RS485, B RS485 are not connected.

right.heading: With telephone line supervision
right.alt: Wiring diagram: control panel to G16T with telephone line supervision. Panel +AUX to G16T +DC, -AUX to -DC, TIP to TIP, RING to RING, T-1 to T1/IN1, R-1 to R1/IN2. G16T terminals OUT, COM, A RS485, B RS485 are not connected.

left.heading: Without telephone line supervision
left.alt: Wiring diagram: arming/disarming the control panel via its keyswitch zone, without telephone line supervision. Panel +AUX to G16T +DC, -AUX to -DC, TIP to TIP, RING to RING, and the panel's keyswitch zone to G16T OUT. COM, A RS485, B RS485 are not connected.

right.heading: With telephone line supervision
right.alt: Wiring diagram: arming/disarming the control panel via its keyswitch zone, with telephone line supervision. Panel +AUX to G16T +DC, -AUX to -DC, TIP to TIP, RING to RING, T-1 to T1/IN1, R-1 to R1/IN2, and the panel's keyswitch zone to G16T OUT. COM, A RS485, B RS485 are not connected.

parts.heading: Normally open (NO)
parts.alt: Input wiring schematic: normally open (NO) contact between COM and INx. Short - Alarm, Open - Restore.

parts.heading: Normally closed (NC)
parts.alt: Input wiring schematic: normally closed (NC) contact between COM and INx. Short - Restore, Open - Alarm.

parts.heading: Normally closed with 10k end-of-line resistor (NC/EOL)
parts.alt: Input wiring schematic: NC contact with a 10k end of line resistor in series between COM and INx (NC/EOL). Short - Alarm, Open - Alarm, 10k - Restore.

parts.heading: Normally open with 10k end-of-line resistor (NO/EOL)
parts.alt: Input wiring schematic: NO contact with a 10k end of line resistor in parallel between COM and INx (NO/EOL). Short - Alarm, Open - Alarm, 10k - Restore.

parts.heading: Normally open with 10k end-of-line resistor and tamper recognition (NO/DEOL)
parts.alt: Input wiring schematic with tamper recognition (NO/DEOL): between COM and INx, a tamper switch and a 10k resistor in series, then the NO contact with a second 10k resistor across it. Short - Tamper, Open - Tamper, 10k - Alarm, 12k-25k - Restore.

parts.heading: Normally closed with 10k end-of-line resistor and tamper recognition (NC/DEOL)
parts.alt: Input wiring schematic with tamper recognition (NC/DEOL): between COM and INx, a tamper switch and a 10k resistor in series, then the NC contact with a second 10k resistor across it. Short - Tamper, Open - Tamper, 10k - Restore, 15k-25k - Alarm.
